authority_basis.summary: Share the completed geometric typing of the formal degree-five deck class.

operations.title: Nima locates the geometric support of degree-five deck data
operations.body: Degree-five geometry is now typed. Using a,b,c with Gram G and d=(a²,b²,c²), four null branches require R0=d^T adj(G)d=0. A fifth point p adds C5=det(G)p²-p^T[a b c]adj(G)d=0. Away from detG=0, all five branches meet iff R0=C5=0. Thus Loewy degree 5 is supported only on a two-discriminant external locus; degrees 1-3 are generic complex-loop strata, degree 4 needs zero circumradius, degree 5 additionally needs fifth-point cosphericity. Event 1197.
